nouns.it.notes: Paragraph antecedents and declared source-action arguments resolve through source identity. A new paragraph lacking an antecedent is an enforced scope rule, not an unimplemented pronoun capability. Plural inflections retain the same configured lexical identity.

nouns.that.notes: Paragraph antecedents and declared source-action arguments resolve through source identity. A new paragraph lacking an antecedent is an enforced scope rule, not an unimplemented pronoun capability. Plural inflections retain the same configured lexical identity.

nouns.this.notes: Paragraph antecedents and declared source-action arguments resolve through source identity. A new paragraph lacking an antecedent is an enforced scope rule, not an unimplemented pronoun capability. Plural inflections retain the same configured lexical identity.

nouns.input.notes: Input metadata covers Function parameters and scoped structured Process bindings. No App process input transport is supplied.

nouns.output.notes: Native process operations and implicit Output/Error require an App. Source-defined actions and explicit members retain lexical precedence.

nouns.error.notes: Native process operations and implicit Output/Error require an App. Source-defined actions and explicit members retain lexical precedence.

nouns.list.notes: Typed owned Lists construct, append, replace and read indexed values. Heterogeneous construction infers Thing without coercion. Indices and complete element types are checked. Iteration/removal remain outside this API.

nouns.dictionary.notes: Dictionary owns lexical members, exports and canonical alias identity. It is a source namespace, not runtime key/value storage. Use Map for that distinct meaning.

nouns.null.notes: Null initializes an explicit absence value. Typed reads preserve evaluation and type/index/key checks. Unassigned storage and the native-definition Null atom remain separate.

nouns.thing.notes: Explicit Thing boundaries retain concrete runtime types. Typed reads validate full element types and callable signatures. No implicit coercion or dynamic arithmetic.

nouns.text.notes: Raw byte Text construction, literal binding, transfer and output implement the documented meaning. Lack of Unicode normalization or a general string-processing library is an API boundary, not an incomplete Text type.

nouns.number.notes: Number is explicitly finite binary64. Parsing, native encoding and typed runtime use implement that meaning. Arbitrary precision and integer-width arithmetic are not promised.

nouns.byte.notes: The configured Byte/Bytes family is recognized, but only Bytes has owned storage. Singular Byte has no scalar source type or one-byte constructor. Octet reads produce Number.

nouns.truth.notes: Truth maps to bool and retains exact typed values. Absence of truthiness and limits on joined condition grammar do not make the value type partial.

nouns.pointer.notes: Managed typed handles share targets. Reads snapshot ordinary contents. Checked mutation rejects ownership cycles, including container and callable-environment edges. No pointer arithmetic or raw-address API.

nouns.op.notes: Configured native representation spelling, not a public application constructor or alias for the source Function, Property or Operation category. Its configuration handler is not executable API evidence.

nouns.prop.notes: Configured native representation spelling, not a public application constructor or alias for the source Function, Property or Operation category. Its configuration handler is not executable API evidence.

nouns.func.notes: Configured native representation spelling, not a public application constructor or alias for the source Function, Property or Operation category. Its configuration handler is not executable API evidence.

nouns.definition.notes: Framed definitions attach to words and composed Functions. The recognized Definition category has no standalone New Definition source constructor for a runtime value to store or inspect.

nouns.attribute.notes: Recognized applicational category and internal Function/Object attributes are implemented. No standalone New Attribute source data-field or runtime-value constructor is supplied.

nouns.object.notes: Object constructs source-file content containing Functions and their definitions. Runtime initialization/lifetime is not part of the documented meaning.

nouns.class.notes: Class constructs ordered module/source groups including nested Classes and Objects. It does not promise a runtime scope or instance lifetime.

nouns.service.notes: Service declarations remain structural. Standalone bodies, packages and native process operations are unsupported. App-constructed Service libraries retain their workspace topology. Static inspection. Witnesses not run.

nouns.app.notes: App construction preserves source graph identity and yields the executable/lifecycle boundary documented by this word. Apps are distinct from structural Services.

verbs.passive.notes: Assignment and same-type scalar equality/inequality are implemented. Definite assignment and rejection of mixed or non-scalar comparisons enforce the documented meaning rather than mark it unfinished.

verbs.associative.notes: One selected registry and source provider implement indexed imports, confined includes and canonical aliases. Unsupported provider names/remote package resolution are outside the explicit-source contract.

verbs.declarative.notes: Registration constructs the named supported value/action with atomic declaration ownership and source identity. Arbitrary English or unspecified native constructors are not promised.

verbs.definitive.notes: Registration binds supported values or explicitly framed typed native definitions, checking slots and lexical ownership. It does not bypass the declared type or visibility rules.

verbs.descriptive.notes: Descriptor construction binds canonical targets and ordered refinements, applies exact target rules and rejects mismatches/cycles. Aliases preserve identity while foreign homonyms remain distinct.

verbs.expansive.notes: Typed updates append/replace List elements, write Map values or replace a Pointer target. Destination kind, keys, element types and managed ownership cycles are checked.

verbs.locative.notes: Typed updates append/replace List elements, write Map values or replace a Pointer target. Destination kind, keys, element types and managed ownership cycles are checked.

verbs.receptive.notes: The configured receptive root parses but has no native instruction role or bound implementation. A public Compile probe of Get 0 from items rejects with unsupported outer instruction action action.receptive. The matched typed read control compiles.

verbs.reductive.notes: The configured reductive root has no native instruction role or bound implementation. A public Compile probe of Take 0 from items reaches unsupported outer instruction action action.reductive. This is known unavailability, not unresolved semantics.

verbs.generative.notes: Native process operations and implicit Output/Error require an App. Source-defined actions and explicit members retain lexical precedence.

verbs.executive.notes: Native process operations and implicit Output/Error require an App. Source-defined actions and explicit members retain lexical precedence.

verbs.suspensive.notes: Native process operations and implicit Output/Error require an App. Source-defined actions and explicit members retain lexical precedence.

verbs.interruptive.notes: Native process operations and implicit Output/Error require an App. Source-defined actions and explicit members retain lexical precedence.

verbs.inflective.notes: The configured inflective action is not the source loader. A public Compile probe of Import `io` rejects with unsupported outer instruction action action.inflective while Use IO from `io` compiles.

verbs.deflective.notes: The configured deflective action has no lowering implementation. A public Compile probe of Export `io` rejects with unsupported outer instruction action action.deflective. Public/Publicly publish declarations. They are not runtime Export aliases.

verbs.observative.notes: The outer instruction uses the selected runtime-value display path, preserving raw Text and adding no LF. Direct App/Error display is outside the declared supported-value domain.

verbs.terminative.notes: The outer instruction terminates the program and owns shutdown/cleanup even from a continuation or source action. Function.Return is deliberately separate. No unawaited continuation is promised.

verbs.appropriative.notes: Has tests the selected App Error, including same-App ownership. General collection membership is a different, unclaimed operation.

verbs.comparative.notes: Equality of matching Text, Number and Truth operands is implemented. No coercion or arbitrary object equality is promised.

adjectives.visibility.public.notes: The declaration modifier publishes one canonical declaration without publishing siblings or cloning dictionary membership. Private captures and definite assignment retain their own checks.

adjectives.initialization.notes: Construction selects the declared noun and exact descriptor refinements with checked operands. There is intentionally no universal constructor, cloning fallback or invented initialization.

adjectives.abstraction.notes: Native source constructors accept explicit ordered parameter atoms through their declared slots. GenericTypes and Lifetimes retain their approved local native-input contract. This does not infer parameters or introduce general L generics.

adverbs.visibility.public.notes: The publication adverb applies to the selected declaration, retaining its identity and defining paragraph. It is a distinct lexical role from Public, with the same checked publication mechanism.

adverbs.nullification.notes: Condition-owned negation is implemented by instructionCondition.Negated and native condition emission. Lack of joined conditions is an And/Or/If limitation, not a missing unary negation implementation.

adverbs.comparison.subtraction.notes: Numeric strict and inclusive comparison are implemented. Rejecting Text ordering is the declared Number-operand contract.

adverbs.comparison.multiplication.notes: Numeric strict and inclusive comparison are implemented. Rejecting Text ordering is the declared Number-operand contract.

adverbs.progression.notes: And then preserves composed action order. Source-action expansion evaluates each complete body before the next coordinated operand. It is a sequencing token, not an asynchronous scheduling feature.

prepositions.definement.declarative.notes: Declaration construction, aliases, typed parameters and invocation result names use the selected owning grammar and canonical binding. No standalone conversion operation is claimed.

prepositions.definement.definitive.notes: Element types/contents and Function signature components are implemented through owner-specific construction and signature extraction.

prepositions.definement.locative.notes: Checked reads and updates bind Number indices or Text keys and retain the selected container and result types. Key and bounds checks are intended behavior.

prepositions.consignment.associative.notes: Function signatures and descriptor-associated child constructions use With under their selected owners. It does not erase argument or descriptor contracts.

prepositions.consignment.inflective.notes: List/Map/Pointer update destinations are lowered and type checked. In has no unclaimed lexical-namespace behavior.

prepositions.consignment.deflective.notes: Generic Function argument phrases accept Out and bind an ordinary argument. The configured consignment.deflective role has no dedicated grammar phrase or executable deflective/output/export operation. Accepting a PREPOSITION in a generic call does not implement that missing role.

prepositions.consignment.indicative.notes: Generic Function argument phrases accept By and bind an ordinary argument. The configured phrase.indicative describes by Actor but no enclosing clause references that phrase to implement actor/passive execution. Generic separator acceptance does not implement that missing role.

prepositions.conjoinment.objective.notes: Indexed/file import sources and checked typed-read sources are implemented by their distinct owners. Provider isolation and read typing are enforced contracts.

prepositions.conjoinment.subjective.notes: Native definition utilization, Function prepositional arguments and inclusive comparison phrases have their documented owner-specific implementations. To has no independent conversion/callback meaning.

prepositions.conjoinment.comparative.notes: Than supplies the comparison relationship in implemented numeric strict and inclusive conditions. Matching Number typing is intentional.

prepositions.conjoinment.directive.notes: For introduces the source-action body. Source instructions expand the selected action with scoped arguments in declared order. It does not introduce a general loop construct.

articles.variable.notes: Any introduces typed source-action parameters or exact descriptor targets. Canonical target checking and rejection of ambiguous antecedents implement its contract, without unrestricted native generic promises.

articles.none.notes: Explicit empty Function Inputs/Outputs and grammar-owned condition negation are implemented. No does not supply implicit initialization.

articles.indefinite.notes: A/An indefinite article family participates in implemented declarations, constructions and Error conditions. It need not select a type independently of its noun.

articles.definite.notes: The selects a definite subject/value in its existing lexical context. App body effects and member Function invocations have maintained witnesses. Visibility rejection is the contract.

conjunctions.mutual.notes: Operand/declaration/action coordination works, but recognized And-joined conditions are explicitly rejected by instructionBuilder.conditional because no Boolean join operator is implemented.

conjunctions.exclusive.notes: Canonical descriptor target alternatives work, but recognized Or-joined conditions are explicitly rejected by instructionBuilder.conditional because no Boolean join operator is implemented.

evaluations.conditional.notes: Single typed conditions produce branches with flow checks. Recognized joined conditions reject during instruction lowering and configured else-if continuation rejects during grammar processing.

evaluations.exceptional.notes: Plain Else works, but the configured conditional.else.if continuation does not parse as an executable chain. Actual valid single-if/else control passes while else-if leaves unassociated else tokens.

evaluations.alternative.notes: Otherwise attaches to the immediately preceding unmatched conditional within the same paragraph. Intervening instructions or paragraph boundaries correctly reject. They are ownership rules rather than missing support.

evaluations.iterative.notes: The configured While loop has no outer instruction implementation: instructionBuilder.statement accepts only if/else/other. The documented While fragment additionally fails grammar processing. Do not claim this fixture reaches lowering or that every possible configured While spelling was probed.
